assessment.match_notes: File:KCl 7.45%.jpg is a real photograph of a labeled potassium chloride solution vial (B. Braun Kaliumchlorid 7,45%). The task requires KCl in the solution state, and this image shows exactly that: an aqueous KCl solution, visually verified as a colorless clear liquid in a glass vial whose label reads 'KCl 7.45%'. The Commons description explicitly states 'potassium chloride 7.45% solution' and the file is categorized under Potassium chloride and Solutions. License is CC BY 4.0 with named author Pavel Dusek (imported from WikiSkripta, Czech medical education wiki); the file carries a pending Commons license-review tag, which is a routine procedural check for WikiSkripta imports rather than a dispute - the author and license declaration are clear. 7.45% (~1 M) is an ordinary dilute-to-moderate solution concentration, honestly representing KCl(aq).
